title: Daily Routines
objectives: Use a glossary or dictionary to check what a word means
Spot topic words for daily routines
Name features of a procedural text (numbered steps, pictures)
Answer literal and inferential questions about a text
Write a simple sentence with a subject and a matching verb
Use always, sometimes and never in full sentences

sentences.text: I wake up at six o'clock.
He takes a shower and gets dressed.
Then he brushes his teeth and eats breakfast.
He never goes to school without breakfast.
Sometimes his dad takes him to school.
After school, he goes home by bus.
She does her homework in the evening.
I always go to bed at eight o'clock.

grammar.title: He wakes up / I wake up
explain: We use the present simple for things we do every day.
I, you, we, they: wake up, eat, go.
He, she, it or a name: add -s or -es: wakes up, eats, goes, brushes.
examples: He goes to school by bus.

practice.explain: brush ends in sh, so we add -es: brushes.

practice.answer: He takes a shower every morning.

grammar.title: always, sometimes, never
explain: These words tell us HOW OFTEN.
always = every time. sometimes = some of the time. never = not at all.
They go before the action word: I always eat breakfast.
examples: I always eat breakfast in the morning.
I sometimes go to school by car.
I never go to bed late on school days.
Ahmed always takes a shower after football.

practice.prompt: Every day, I brush my teeth. I ___ brush my teeth.
I don't drink coffee. I ___ drink coffee.
Some days Dad takes me to school. ___ Dad takes me to school.
Which word means “not at any time”?

practice.answer: I sometimes play football after school.
He never watches TV before homework.

grammar.title: First, then, after
explain: Order words tell us WHEN things happen.

practice.prompt: Which word starts a list of steps?
Which word tells us the LAST step?
What do you do first in the morning?
Put the morning routine in order.

reading.title: Saif's Busy Day
paragraphs: Saif always wakes up at half past six. First, he takes a shower. Then, he gets dressed in his school uniform and brushes his teeth.
After that, Saif eats breakfast with his sister, Latifa. He always eats eggs and bread. He never goes to school without breakfast.
Saif usually goes to school by bus. Sometimes, his mum takes him in the car. At school, he sits next to his best friend, Khalid.
After school, Saif plays football in the park. In the evening, he eats dinner with his family and does his homework. Finally, at eight o'clock, he goes to bed.
